notes: Shopify storefront. Dropped as 0-qty: 'Holiday Tree Kits' (NO RESULTS FOUND). Dropped as duplicate: 'Ornaments & Tree Trimming' (slug ornaments-garland) - identical 2-item listing (Hand-Beaded Snowflake Tree Skirt, Riad Tree Skirt) to 'Tree Skirts', kept 'Tree Skirts' as the correctly-titled canonical row. 'Holiday Decor' (20 items) is kept as its own real leaf row (not nulled to a grouping row) because the site reports a genuine, independently exact count for it beyond just summing the listed children (it also contains general candle-holder/faux-fur items covered by the excluded general categories); 'Trees & Trimmings' (1 item) and 'Trees' (2 items) both genuinely exist as separate collections with overlapping but non-identical product sets, so both are kept. 'Tree Skirts & Stockings' (4 items) is a genuine grouping page whose content is exactly the union of 'Tree Skirts' (2) and 'Stockings & Stocking Holders' (2), so it is recorded as a grouping row.
